review.tagline: LangGraph ReAct agent and FastHTML chat UI in one deployment
review.summary: A Python project where langgraph.json mounts both a ReAct agent graph and a FastHTML chat page, so one langgraph dev process on port 2024 serves the UI and the agent. The model defaults to Claude 3.5 Sonnet with OpenAI as the alternative, Tavily search is the only tool, and there is no auth and no chat history persistence. For Python developers targeting LangGraph Platform who want a UI without a JavaScript build.
review.audience: Python developers deploying to LangGraph Platform
strengths: One process serves agent and UI; deploys as a single LangGraph app
Unit and integration test workflows run in CI
weaknesses: No persistent chat history; the README lists it as a next step
Default model string claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 is dated
Server-rendered FastHTML UI; limited for rich client-side features
